rigs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production-ready CUTOUT RIG PARTS sprite atlas for a smoothly animated desktop character. The attached knight sheet is a STYLE reference only: closely match its premium chibi game rendering, huge head, little body, crisp dark outlined forms, beautiful glossy material gradients, metal highlights, charming glowing or expressive eyes, warm gold edging, saturated accents. This is NOT a page of poses. Make one new atlas with EXACTLY FOUR columns and THREE rows, twelve equal rectangular cells, alpha transparent background, no text, no numbers, no guide/grid lines, no assembled characters except final cell. Every part fits separately in its cell with at least 15% transparent margin; nothing crosses a cell boundary. All parts face right in the same three-quarter view and have consistent lighting from upper left. Limb segments are drawn upright, proximal joint at TOP, distal joint at BOTTOM, naturally downward, rounded ends for overlapping joints. NO weapon in any cell. Reading-order cell specification: [0] complete LARGE HEAD with all hat/hair/helmet decorations, no neck/body. [1] complete TORSO with waist/hip clothing, no head, no arms, no legs, compact chibi proportions. [2] near UPPER ARM only from rounded shoulder to elbow, vertical. [3] near FOREARM plus closed empty fist/glove, elbow at top wrist at bottom. [4] far UPPER ARM only, vertical. [5] far FOREARM plus closed empty hand. [6] near THIGH only from hip to knee, vertical. [7] near SHIN with boot/foot, knee at top, foot at bottom angled right. [8] far THIGH only. [9] far SHIN with boot/foot. [10] complete separate flowing CAPE / garment-tail cloth, broad attachment at top, tapered/wavy trailing bottom, no character behind it. [11] a COMPLETE assembled reference character, standing neutral facing right, no weapon, no background, made of exactly these parts. The pieces should look like painted game animation cutouts, with full volume and detail like the reference, NOT flat vector icons. No detached scenery, no decorative frame, no watermark. CHARACTER: a heroic tiny armored medieval knight matching the reference. Polished silver-blue rounded plate armor, gold seams/rivets, black visor with TWO bright amber glowing eyes, red sweeping helmet plume, crimson flowing cape, small rounded armored gauntlets, silver armored thighs and shin-boots. Cute confident stout build, very large helmet. Keep knight exactly in this design consistently in all parts.
